Body.Content:
Azure SQL Data Warehouse provides 3x increase in performance and bottomless columnar storage. Later in July 2017, users can provision new preview instances of Azure SQL Data Warehouse at DW9000 and DW18000. They can scale with more compute capacity than ever before to answer analytical queries using our fully featured SQL engine. Azure SQL Data Warehouse will also support bottomless columnar storage at these new performance levels.

Learn more
